summary: Improve task allocation, feedback and performance follow-through with practical supervisory tools. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Advanced supervision helps frontline supervisors, team leaders and operational coordinators turn shifting priorities into clear assignments and consistent follow-through. For people already coordinating staff or workflow, the course practises setting SMART objectives, allocating work with RACI and coaching performance with SBI feedback. You will also use scorecards and PDCA cycles to analyse recurring problems, document actions and report progress.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits people who already coordinate staff or workflow and need stronger methods for day-to-day supervision, performance conversations and follow-through.
prerequisites: Prior experience supervising staff, coordinating team tasks or overseeing operational workflow is recommended. You should be ready to work with routine performance measures and practical team scenarios. No programming is required.
